facebook.text:
Reviews are the new word of mouth. Here's how to get more without begging.

The system is simple: ask at the moment of gratitude — right after someone thanks you, completes a project, or walks out of a great service. Send them a direct link to your Google review page. Make it a 60-second task.

One review a week. That's it. Over a year, that compounds into the kind of local credibility money can't buy.

For churches especially: your Google listing is the new front door. People search before they visit. What they find matters.
